milestones.title: Foundation: repo, tokens, manifest, licenses, registry pipeline
acceptance_criteria: `npm run verify` passes on a fresh clone; the manifest check counts exactly 42/7/12/32 entries and 22 linked enhancements; the license register covers the four sources; `npx shadcn add` of a proof item from the local registry installs into a scratch Next app that builds; the kit-only check fails on a planted violation.

milestones.title: 30 P1 shadcn components with their Animate UI enhancements
acceptance_criteria: the 30 P1 entries (§3.1–3.6) are `validated` or `implemented`/`blocked` with reason; each of the P1-related enhancements (Select, Checkbox, Switch, Combobox, Sidebar, Tabs, Dropdown Menu, Pagination, Dialog, Alert Dialog, Sheet, Popover, Tooltip, Accordion, Toast) has a result; each validated entry has a demo, unit tests, an axe-clean e2e and a reduced-motion e2e; one notification engine.

milestones.title: Private catalog application built with the kit
acceptance_criteria: the catalog lists all entries from the manifest with filters by source, category, priority, status and type, command-palette search, entry pages with live demo, states, props table, install command, origin/license/version, light/dark, viewport preview and motion-profile switch; login protects pages and a bearer token protects `/r/*`; `check:kit-only` passes; every UI piece the app needed is a kit entry (catalog-driven additions recorded).

milestones.title: P2 components, remaining enhancements and the 7 Animate UI capabilities
acceptance_criteria: the 12 P2 entries (§3.7) and the 7 capabilities (§5) have a final status; the remaining enhancements (Radio Group, Navigation Menu, Drawer, Collapsible, Progress, Slider, Hover Card) have a result, so all 22 are resolved; each capability has its API decision (component, hook or variant) recorded in the manifest.

milestones.title: Bencho UI (12)
acceptance_criteria: the 12 Bencho entries have a final status with origin (`bencho` or `own (inspired by bencho)` per license); APIs follow §10.2/§10.3 (one value model with Slider/Select/Checkbox/Counting Number, Toast Stack is a presenter on the single engine); every gesture has a keyboard/button alternative; mobile scroll conflicts tested.

milestones.title: React Bits Free (32)
acceptance_criteria: the 32 entries (§11.1–11.4) have a final status, Commons Clause notices kept, tokens wired (tints, sizes, fonts), SSR/hydration clean, reduced-motion respected; backgrounds lazy-load, pause off-screen and fall back without WebGL.

milestones.title: Agent index, deployment and acceptance
acceptance_criteria: `/r/index.json`, `/llms.txt` and repo `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` list every entry with install command, origin, version, dependencies, license and QA status; the catalog is live on Netlify behind login, `/r/*` answers 401 without token; the end-to-end flow passes against the built app; the independent audit ledger has no open blocking finding.
